stories.title: Election Integrity or Election Sabotage? Trump Vows to Block Alaska Senate Certification if GOP Loses
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Moves to Protect Alaska Ballot Integrity as Democrats Cry Foul Over Routine Legal Challenge
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Says He's Already Ordered a Lawsuit to Block Certification if His Candidate Loses Alaska
stories.poll_option1_desc: Legal challenges are a normal safeguard against fraudulent or sloppy vote counts.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Pre-announcing refusal to accept results is an attack on democracy.

stories.title: Justice Restored or Revenge Prosecution? Judge Blasts DOJ Case Against Ex-FBI Officials
stories.conservative_headline: DOJ Finally Holds Deep State FBI Officials Accountable for Lying About the Hunter Biden Laptop Probe
stories.liberal_headline: Judge Torches Trump Prosecutors as Retribution Cases Against FBI Officials Collapse in Court
stories.poll_question: Are the FBI prosecutions justice or payback?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Officials who misled investigators must face the same law as everyone else.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Weak cases built to punish Trump's enemies, as judges keep pointing out.

stories.title: Patience or Paralysis? Fed Holds Rates as Inflation Runs Hot Days Before the Midterms
stories.conservative_headline: Fed Stands Firm Against Inflation as Trump Economy Powers AI Boom and Energy Independence
stories.liberal_headline: Prices Keep Climbing and Hiring Stalls: Fed Freezes Rates as Voters Blame Trump for the Squeeze
stories.poll_option1_desc: Oil shocks and past spending drive prices; growth and investment are strong.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Tariffs and chaos raised costs while wages fall behind prices.

stories.title: Officer Safety or Disappearing People? Lawsuit Targets ICE Hiding Detainee Locations
stories.conservative_headline: Activist Lawyers Sue to Force ICE to Reveal Detainee Locations, Slowing Removal of Criminal Illegals
stories.liberal_headline: ICE Is Making Detainees Vanish: Lawsuit Says Families and Lawyers Can No Longer Find Them
stories.poll_option1_desc: Secrecy prevents obstruction and speeds deportation of those already ordered removed.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Hiding detainees from their own lawyers is cruel and likely unlawful.

stories.title: Parental Rights or State Overreach? DOJ Sues Maryland District Over Trans Student Policy
stories.conservative_headline: DOJ Sues Maryland District for Hiding Secret Gender Transitions From Parents
stories.liberal_headline: Trump DOJ Escalates War on Trans Kids, Suing School District for Protecting Student Privacy
stories.poll_question: Must schools tell parents about gender identity?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Schools can't keep life-altering decisions about children secret from their families.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Forced outing endangers vulnerable kids in unsupportive or hostile homes.

stories.title: Energy Freedom or Climate Surrender? White House Moves to Scrap Methane Rules
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Frees American Energy From Biden Methane Red Tape as Voters Demand Lower Fuel Costs
stories.liberal_headline: White House Guts Methane Limits, Handing Oil Giants a Gift as the Climate Clock Runs Out
stories.poll_question: Should methane emission rules be rolled back?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Cutting red tape lowers energy prices and ends reliance on foreign oil.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Methane is a potent climate pollutant; rollback is a giveaway to polluters.

stories.title: Lawful Strikes or Extrajudicial Killings? Caribbean Boat Campaign Faces New Scrutiny
stories.conservative_headline: Pentagon Keeps Narco-Terrorists From Poisoning America as Strikes Cripple Cartel Smuggling Routes
stories.liberal_headline: Dozens Killed Without Trial: Legal Experts Say Boat Strikes Violate the Law and Congress Was Cut Out
stories.poll_question: Are the lethal boat strikes legal?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Cartels are terrorists waging an armed attack; the military can strike them.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Suspects killed without evidence, trial, or congressional authorization under international law.

stories.title: Judicial Restraint or Rigging the Midterms? SCOTUS Election Rulings Draw Kagan's Rebuke
stories.conservative_headline: Supreme Court Stops Last-Minute Judicial Meddling in State Election Rules Just Before Voting
stories.liberal_headline: Kagan Warns Her Own Court Is Rewriting Election Rules to Help Republicans Weeks Before the Vote
stories.poll_question: Is the Court playing favorites in election cases?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Courts shouldn't change voting rules at the last minute; states decide.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Emergency orders consistently favor the GOP and suppress student and minority votes.

stories.title: Protecting Patients or Caving to Activists? Court Blocks Trans Care Ban in Federal Prisons
stories.conservative_headline: Court Forces Taxpayers to Keep Funding Inmate Gender Treatments Trump Tried to End
stories.liberal_headline: Even This Supreme Court Says Trump Can't Deny Trans Prisoners Medically Necessary Health Care
stories.poll_question: Should federal prisons provide gender-affirming care?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Taxpayers shouldn't fund elective gender treatments for federal inmates.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Denying prescribed treatment to prisoners is cruel and unconstitutional.

stories.title: Free Speech or Theft? Neil Young Sues Trump Committee Over Rally Music
stories.conservative_headline: Washed-Up Rocker Sues Trump Again Over a Song Played at a Rally as Democrats Cheer
stories.liberal_headline: Neil Young Sues for $10 Million After Trump Campaign Keeps Using His Music Without Permission
stories.poll_question: Can campaigns play songs artists object to?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Venues hold blanket licenses; artists can't veto who plays their music.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Creators deserve control over political use of their work, full stop.
